body:
## Problem
Once **Run review** is pressed, the human loses track of the review.

- `sysreview.run_view` shows "Review started: … Its findings will appear as tasks in Planning." only until the page reloads. After a reload, nothing on the page says a review is running.
- `system_reviews.past` (`GET /system-reviews`) keeps only runs with `state == "ended"` and `outcome == "finished"`. A review whose agent fails, is stopped or is interrupted never shows anywhere. The human waits for Planning tasks that will never come.
- D-24 says a human can follow a run and that a failed run says why. System review runs get neither.

## Change
1. Server: make `system_reviews.past` list every system review run (or add `GET /system-reviews/runs`). Each entry gets its `state` and `outcome`, plus the run's last agent message or failure text when it has one. Keep newest first. `SYSTEMREVIEWS.md` stays completed-only (D-265).
2. Page (`solace-cli/sysreview/src/sysreview.gleam`):
   - Load that list when the page opens. On the Run tab, show "A review is running (started <clock>): <kinds>" while one is open.
   - Disable **Run review** while a review runs, or keep the server's refusal and show it.
   - On the Past tab, add a **State** column: Finished, Running, Failed or Stopped. A failed row's dialog shows the reason.
   - Rename the tab if it is no longer completed-only.
3. Refresh the list when a review run ends, for example from the event stream the page already uses for `missedReviews`.

## Check
- Add a Rust test beside `board::server::tests.a_system_review_needs_known_kinds`. Start a review, end its run as failed, and check that `GET /system-reviews` lists it with `state` and `outcome`.
- Add Gleam tests in `test/sysreview_test.gleam`: a running review shows the running line and disables Run review, and a failed review's row reads "Failed".
- By hand: start a review with no reviewer model available. The page says it failed and why.
title: Show running and failed system reviews
